notes: One feature per day, in order. Facts in 'brief' are the only claims allowed in the post. 'screens' are suggestions; if empty, use the cards-only layout (no front/back).

features.brief: Customers follow every order live: Accepted, Cooking, Ready, Out for delivery, Delivered. Fewer 'where is my order' calls.
Every restaurant gets its own branded ordering site at <slug>.tastedesk.am with its photos, address and live open/closed status. No aggregator branding, customers order directly from the restaurant.
Restaurant staff see all incoming orders on one live order board and move them through statuses with one tap; the customer's tracking page updates instantly.
One app for delivery, pickup (takeout) and dine-in. Customer picks how they get the order at checkout; pickup shows the restaurant address and ready time.
Kitchen and cashier stations. Every order automatically prints a receipt at the right station, so the kitchen never misses a ticket.
Online payments with AmeriaBank, Arca, Idram, Telcell, plus cash. Customer chooses at checkout.
0 dram setup fee. The restaurant pays only when the app brings orders.
Checkout address autocomplete with a map pin, plus entrance, floor, apartment and courier phone fields, so couriers find the door the first time.
Table map with live table statuses and a QR code on every table: guests scan, see the menu and order from their phone.
Menu with categories and photo product pages, ingredients, stock left, and a note for the kitchen on every item.
iiko integration: menu syncs from iiko, orders are pushed into iiko, and items on the iiko stop list are hidden automatically.
Customers sign in with their phone number; saved addresses and full order history let them reorder in seconds.
Staff roles: waiter, manager, courier, storekeeper, marketer. Everyone sees only what they need.
Delivery zones and delivery fee by distance, shown to the customer at checkout before they order.
Courier role: couriers get their own view of orders ready for delivery and mark them out for delivery and delivered.
Opening hours: the site shows open/closed automatically, e.g. 'Open until 05:00', so customers never order from a closed kitchen.
Staff can enter phone and walk-in orders themselves, so every channel lands on the same board.
Loyalty points: customers earn points on orders and redeem them on later orders.
A dashboard with the restaurant's orders and sales at a glance.
All channels in one place: website orders, table QR orders, phone and walk-in orders, all on one board.
Restaurants manage products, categories and ingredients themselves; changes are live on the site immediately.
SEO-ready pages for the restaurant and every product, so the restaurant's menu can be found on Google.
Kitchen flow: orders go from accepted to cooking to ready in a clear sequence, with tickets printed at the kitchen station.
